# Public test vectors for the nimiq package tests (one "name = value" per
# line, "#" starts a comment). Kept as data rather than as string literals in
# the _test.go files so the sources stay free of long hex constants.

# bip39.*   Trezor python-mnemonic vectors.json (English, empty passphrase).
# slip10.*  SLIP-0010 ed25519 test vector 1 (seed 000102…0f), chain m and m/0'.
# tx.*      Golden Nimiq basic transaction: Blake2b-256 of SerializeContent,
#           verified live against a testnet node (rpc.testnet.nimiqwatch.com).
